title: Pompeii Had One Day to Escape. Most of Them Chose to Stay.
description:
They thought they had time.
The terrible truth is that they did — they just didn't know what it was for.

On the morning of August 24th, 79 AD, the people of Pompeii woke to an ordinary day. What followed was not a sudden catastrophe — it was a slow, reasonable series of decisions that led thousands of people to wait, shelter, and hope, while the window to escape quietly closed around them. This is the story of the hours before the end, and the families who ran toward the sea believing rescue was coming.
